warnings: Two-pile footings. Plan sizes from the printed edge/pile-spacing chains (kept in *_printed_as); thickness 0.70 (F2) / 0.50 (F2A) from the section; lean concrete 0.05 on sand. The pile spec (prestressed spun pile dia 0.25 m or 0.22 x 0.22 m square, 21.00 m in 2 welded pieces, >= 25 t each) is from the รายการประกอบแบบฐานราก block on the same sheet.
The column stub drawn above each footing carries no separate size/rebar on this sheet; the column table is S-06 (page 18).
